lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 101610101
Rouge has invited {AccountData.NickName} to join the group.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Hello, Highroller.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Forgive me for inviting you so suddenly,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: but I feel I was a bit aloof previously, so I wanted to talk with you.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: As you know, luck has been in your favor,

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: so you will get what your heart desires.
Thank you.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I wasn't fishing for a compliment.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: And

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: one more thing...
Blanc has joined the group.
Noir has joined the group.
What's going on?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: What do you mean what's going on?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Pit Boss?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: How did you two get in here?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I noticed you've been staring at your phone for a while now,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: so I snuck a peek at the group name and joined.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Good grief...

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I thought I had this group set on private.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Guess not! The name popped up as soon as I searched it.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Wait a moment.
Rouge has changed the group settings.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: There.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: What were you and Pit Boss talking about?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Yeah, why did you create a private group chat?

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Nothing special.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Isn't that right?
Yep, nothing unusual over here.
Nothing special? I thought we had something, Rouge.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: What are you talking about?
Hehehe.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: ... Please don't joke around like that.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Well, at any rate,

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: it seems like you two were having a good time.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Now that Noir and I have joined, don't forget about us the next time you're off having fun.

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Yeah, it'll be way more fun with us around!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: I was just giving my thoughts on the upcoming event.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Well, not my personal thoughts necessarily, more like notices and stuff like that.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Ah, so this is just a temporary group?

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: I was wondering why it was called "Bunny Room", what a strange name!

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Heh-heh.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Well, the casino is about to open.

lines.speaker: rouge
lines.text: Let's get ready.

lines.speaker: blanc
lines.text: Okie-dokie!

lines.speaker: noir
lines.text: Okay...
